demonstrates: optiland.backend.set_backend('torch') + set_device + set_precision + get_precision + grad_mode.enable, torch tensors as surface radii and thicknesses, reverse-mode gradients through Optic.trace, and an Adam loop. Establishes that the torch backend defaults to float32.
notes: optiland.backend state is process-global and not thread-safe. This module restores the entering backend and float32 precision in a finally block so a pytest session that imports it does not leak the torch backend into other tests.
title: Differentiable Ray Tracing
